programme.desc: S212 E05 — Big Personalities Making Big Moves Couples uprooting to Australia and Spain want big adventures, but their even bigger personalities keep stealing the spotlight. They're attempting to refocus on finding a home, but these magnetic movers may just keep attracting drama.

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International
